seed_policy: arm9 unconditional B/BL branch targets plus push{...,lr} prologues
finding: Branch-target seeds produced mostly mid-routine fragments. The byte-exact blocks are self-contained code ranges, but they are indistinguishable by inspection from compiler-shared return/case blocks reached by multiple tail branches (e.g. shared return-0 and return-0x7fffffff tails); independent lane reviews disagreed on whether any is a real function.
action: No wave-7-10 result was credited or added to the strict inventory. functions-v5 remains the 660-entry reviewed set. A reviewed classification (function vs shared block: e.g. reference origin clustering, call-graph ownership) is required before any can be accepted.
conclusion: The bounded ARM9 leaf pool is effectively exhausted. Further verified gains need overlay/Thumb support, call-aware reconstruction, or a reviewed tail-call/shared-block classifier.
